scope: Expose complete ordinary-image create-only recursive FAT extraction through the common command/operation service and actual CLI, protocol, GUI, TUI and interactive shell. Retain the full current 0.1.0 scope. No physical/elevation/customer/install/sign/release or production broker/journal admission.

command.preparation: Observe ordinary source, selected volume/copy, explicit OEM/name/time policy, all destination/ledger/operation-store/code dependencies and finite budgets without output creation. Use an owned reader/preparator; return an immutable review definition plus separate observation/admission facts. Static help/discovery never initializes a provider.
command.execution: Exact review digest plus separate source-read, destination-tree, ledger, operation-store and declared-host grants. Reobserve all actual resources and independently prepare a new owned backend. Compare stable intended effects/resources/namespace against review before any output. Return a durable operation identity for accepted_running; record actual process identity/code/attempt/epoch. Existing filesystem.extract and raw/logical plans retain their meanings.
command.registry_owner: spec/catalog/commands.json#filesystem.tree.extract; no alternate parser/registry in this profile
command.parameters: urn:disked:schema:fat-recursive-command-parameters:1. Prepare takes phase/source/destination operands plus ledger/state-dir, selected volume offset/bytes/copy, capture epoch and explicit OEM437/850. Name defaults long_or_short, unrepresentable defaults refuse, time defaults preserve_raw and offset0; fixed_offset requires explicit offset. Execute takes immutable definition (<=32768 canonical bytes), exact domain-separated review digest and all five true grants. No preparation fields or unknown fields in execute. This is a provisional inline64KiB request profile, not a permanent storage ABI.
command.digest: sha256 of UTF8 disked:fat-tree-extraction-review:1 followed by LF and canonical immutable review JSON; preserve original private review1 meaning.

review_definition.content: An immutable supplied-byte model with a stable projection of the qualified private backend definition: exact selected source/epoch/window/copy, namespace commitment, resource identities/epochs/access/aliases/footprints/verification, canonical locations, metadata policy, budgets and execution generation. Separate explicit operation_store dependency and finite child/evidence footprint. Worker PID, capture ID/sequence and attempt observations belong in receipts, not this effect digest. Preserve the existing process-bound private plan1 unchanged.
review_definition.validation: Strict known mutation-critical fields and bounded decimal integers; no unknown effects/options, source writes, overwrite/delete/force, guessed encoding/timezone, undeclared scratch/recovery resources or grant/acceptance state inside the review definition. A matching imported hash establishes no actor/source/store authentication. Native admission independently compares its owned observations before granting effects.
review_definition.operation_store: Existing ordinary local NTFS directory with exact path/ancestor/directory identity and epoch, explicitly declared finite request/cancel/state children and observation-only reconnect. Grant store effects separately. Bind store/source/code/destination/ledger aliases and dependency ownership before effects; no new incidental state location or automatic cleanup. Selected private review1 control footprint names recursive-request.json, recursive-cancel and recursive-state.ndjson, bounded to 16384 bytes per state record, 1048576 control-history bytes and 64 state records. Original extraction ledger remains a separately declared resource with its own limits.

lifecycle: Prepared reviews do not keep a CLI worker secretly alive. Execution mints a fresh attempt/capture/admission receipt against the same immutable effect definition. Durable operation inspect/wait/watch/cancel reconnect by exact operation/store/code/process identities, observation-only. Active, completed, partial and uncertain states distinguish publication from actual exit and preserve source/code/store/ledger dependencies. No restart/replay/cleanup or new writer from timeout, cancellation or imported history.
interfaces: One descriptor-owned grammar and typed command service shared by CLI/protocol/GUI/TUI/shell. Bind fields/diagnostics/exit outcomes before implementation. Invalid invocations and missing/wrong grants have no provider/output effects as applicable. Bounded pending requests/late observations do not block UI pumps or alter sibling command semantics. Machine output remains noninteractive.
qualification: Independent review-projection/hash/shape/conservation/grant fixtures; stability across real process/capture epochs and sensitivity to every intended resource/policy/effect/namespace/store/code change.

Actual owned prepare/execute/reconnect/cancel/wait/late/hang/exit cases using only generated ordinary images and new trees/stores. Missing/stale/poisoned reviews or grants create no output; source bytes unchanged.
Actual CLI/protocol/GUI/TUI/shell recursive prepare/execution/observation journeys share semantics, source identity and native output/evidence expectations.
Fresh exact-source full native/header/dependency/import/context/manifest/tooling and artifact evidence; old raw/logical/tree commands and limits retain their independent regressions.

native_admission.store: Observe and pin the actual ordinary local NTFS directory/ancestor closure. Require the three reserved control names absent before preparation/admission, reject source/output/code aliases to those names and preserve unrelated/foreign resources. Native file identities and the stable review are compared before effects.
native_admission.claim: After all five exact-review grants and a fresh owned preparation agree, claim recursive-request.json using CREATE_NEW with current-user ACL, then create cancellation/state files without clobbering. The retained request binds review, operation/attempt/worker/code identities and created child identities. Record and flush a dispatch intent before sending the private exact-plan grant. An observed creation or interrupted initialization is retained; no implicit cleanup/retry.
native_admission.bounds: Request header <=524288 bytes; each state record <=16384 bytes; at most64 state records; total request/cancel/state bytes <=1048576 including header and cancel byte. State observation may coalesce progress, reserving space for publication/exit/uncertainty facts. Original extraction metadata ledger remains separate.
native_admission.lifetime: Attach the owned store to the existing worker dependency closure before launch so uncertain retirement retains all source/code/store/ledger dependencies until actual exit. No second scheduler/retention framework. Publication and exit are recorded separately; caller/process/store failures preserve uncertainty.
native_admission.qualification: Actual generated-image/store preparation and execution, independently read control header/hash-chain/IDs and destination bytes, missing/stale/changed/forged grants/reviews, preexisting/racing reserved files, source/store changes, cancellation/late/hang/exit and ownership through retirement. Common reconnect/frontends/full clean-source gates remain.

detached_controller.handoff: Validate exact immutable review and all five grants before any native path or process effect. Launch the same executable with a bounded capability-only input, output and explicit dispatch gate. No source/store/output work before dispatch. Caller abandonment or death before dispatch admits no effects. After dispatch the controller owns the existing admission/worker/store dependency closure independently of caller lifetime; loss of the caller does not cancel or replay it.
detached_controller.identity: Bind input digest, reviewed code generation, host and exact controller process birth. A running accepted operation requires a nonempty retained operation ID. Transfer-pending is not accepted_running. Publish bounded observations separately from retained operation state; publication alone proves neither physical effects nor actual exit. Controller input-prototype/2 allocates one operation ID in the caller before dispatch and supplies it to native admission. Pending/unknown responses can retain that proposed ID and exact store for later inspection; it is not proof of a claim or accepted_running. Newly flushed request2 binds that same ID. Refusal with no claim retains no admitted operation.
detached_controller.budgets: Controller shares the existing aggregate four-worker/512MiB budget and has a separate two-process/256MiB job without kill-on-caller-handle-close. Preparation is limited to10s; execution has a30s progress-stall budget and1h absolute budget. A reached budget requests cooperative stop and retires only the owned worker job, retains uncertainty and never starts a replacement. Test-only shorter stall injection is excluded from normal binaries. Input<=524288 bytes and published snapshot<=32768 bytes; no stdout/console or arbitrary inherited handles.
detached_controller.qualification: Actual caller exit before/after dispatch, source preservation, independent store/header/process observations, exact output completion, cross-process cancellation and published-before-exit. Missing/wrong grants, stale source/store/code, reused launch/dispatch, early abandonment, malformed/private role invocation and owned hung-worker exit remain explicit cases. No live owner replacement on an observation timeout. Common frontends/full-source qualification remain.

watch.cursor: Private recursive-control event sequence is retained zero-based record index plus one; cursor0 emits the admission record as event1. Preserve the original state-record indices and SHA256 over canonical record bytes including LF. Positive after_sequence requires the exact retained digest and worker_epoch; snapshot cannot accompany a positive cursor. Bind each observer to exact header/review/operation/attempt/worker identities. A changed or shortened prefix is a conflict, not permission to resnapshot silently.
watch.events: Use org.disked.event/1 envelopes with fat.tree.operation.record/snapshot and org.disked.fat-tree-operation-event-prototype/1 payload. Include request correlation, fresh watch observer epoch, exact retained record, record_digest and explicit sequence domain. Maximum64 events,16384 bytes per event and1048576 aggregate event bytes. A rejected callback closes only the observer; cursor advances only after the sink admits the event. No silent drops, gaps, replacement worker or cancellation side effect.
watch.following: Follow_ms0..2000; poll at25ms, at most81 observations. This bounds following between native calls, not a blocked OS file API. Actual public frontends must retain existing bounded-request containment. Return recorded_terminal only for an intact retained exit declaration, following_boundary only with matching live controller/writer, otherwise unknown/observer_closed with reason and last admitted cursor. Retained outcome and current native facts remain separate. Wait uses the same bounded observer in snapshot mode, with no replay or execution effect. A matching live controller may be followed while an exited/absent writer awaits the retained exit flush; if the budget ends first, report unknown with retained_exit_pending, never accepted_running from that stale record. Control artifacts must be fully identity-checked before exporting a history. Intact retained exit declarations can be read even if present-day process facts are unavailable; preserve those native diagnostics. Known reused/code-mismatched live domains end observation. Unavailable/absent facts may be reobserved within the finite budget, stay unknown, and authorize no cancellation or restart.
watch.qualification: Independent exact envelopes/raw digests/sequence-domain/cursor tests; replay, resumption, snapshots, ahead/wrong digest/epoch, changed/shrunk header/prefix and full/torn histories; event and aggregate budgets; stopped sink; real second-process wait/watch over live detached completion/cancellation/published-before-exit, source/output/control preservation. Public protocol/reader/frontend qualification remains.

reconnect.header_versions: Read existing request-prototype/1 as historical evidence. New request-prototype/2 also binds actual controller and writer PID/creation identities; writer/code/attempt/epochs remain independently bound. Header/record consistency or hash equality is not authenticity or current source/destination verification.
reconnect.inspection: Validate bounded canonical header and complete state-record prefixes, sequence/hash/operation/review/process/code/capture/attempt bindings, admissible phase progression and status-dependent outcome counters. Count/hash an incomplete tail separately without admitting it. Reject contradictory complete records including recomputed chains. Preserve declarations independently of current native facts.
reconnect.native_observation: Open only the requested ordinary NTFS store/control artifacts, bind actual directory/ancestor/child identities, host identity and canonical header. Query exact recorded controller/writer process birth and actual executable generation where available. Distinguish matching running/exited handles, absent PID, reused/mismatched identity and unavailable observation. No current source/destination access or new writer.
reconnect.cancellation: Only header2 with intact records/control identity and matching live controller/writer/code can receive a one-byte cancellation request. It is a request, not acknowledgement or exit. The existing owning controller polls its owned cancellation file and forwards stop even if persistence fails. History-only/identity-conflicting/unavailable/torn states do not grant cancellation or restart; completed operation reports too-late conservatively.
reconnect.qualification: Independent header/history/canonical/hash/shape/phase/counter/identity tests, old-version reading, torn/full tampering including rehashed rows, native cross-process inspect/cancel while writer alive, published result before exit, code/process/store/child mismatch and unchanged bytes on refused requests. Detached execution/common wait/watch/frontends/full-source qualification remain.

product_development.composition: disked_recursive_test, explicit DISKED_RECURSIVE_COMMAND_TESTING build only; normal disked remains unavailable
product_development.routing: One shared runtime command service and native action ports through existing CLI/protocol/GUI/TUI/shell bounded dispatch. Entry registers only same-executable capability-bound controller/writer roles in this development composition. No new scheduler or physical/elevation/customer/install/release authority.
product_development.operations: Extend canonical operation-id scalar/schema to tree-op with exact32hex suffix. Disabled compositions refuse before paths. Inspect/cancel/watch use the existing declared store and separate retained/current facts. Watch NDJSON requires org.disked.fat-tree-operation-events/1; wrong features refuse before paths. Streaming final has empty events and retained cursor.
product_development.bounds: Recursive responses<=2097151 bytes plus LF,131072 values,depth40,string65536. Existing4s request/3s output bounds and occupied-slot retention remain. Event queue remains64/1MiB/16KiB. GUI/TUI/shell use escaped complete content or refuse; no truncation.
product_development.acceptance: Actual static discovery/help and disabled normal composition, generated FAT12/16/32 CLI/protocol prepare/execute/exact output/source preservation, all grants, same-op inspect/cancel/watch cursor/digests and negotiation; actual Win32 GUI and owned hidden TUI/shell preparation/execution/restoration. Other profiles and release remain unqualified.
product_development.reader: Compatible supplied-header reader preserves additive outer/payload observations, rejects unknown required features, wrong types/identity/epoch/observer/digest/sequence/gaps/conflicting duplicates without cursor mutation, validates complete replay against the retained graph. Requested snapshot verifies the exact record but marks omitted_prefix_verified=false; it neither reconstructs missing history nor authenticates a producer.

failure_development.controls: Execution-only worker fault and bounded full/short/flush store faults in a separate compiled fixture. Ordinary actions ignore environment controls; public schemas reject fault fields. Private controller input transfers store controls explicitly; normal child environment policy stays unchanged.
failure_development.verified: Actual CLI/protocol/GUI/TUI/shell cancellation after launching client exit; same operation identity, recorded partial cancellation, unchanged sources; no replay after uncertain store full/short/flush; exact-prefix inspection separate from terminal operation; source/stale/foreign resources refused.
failure_development.remaining: Full exact-source normal composition qualification and owner work review.

interruption_development.verified: Closed actual NDJSON watch pipe seals its caller without cancelling independently owned execution; same digest-bound cursor resumes. Unresponsive writer retires under the existing30s budget; abrupt exit and uncertain outcomes never admit replacement.
interruption_development.semantics: Closed emitted envelope/payload/record/worker/outcome shapes with automatic u64/u32, frame, SHA256(canonical record+LF), sequence domain, process/dependency/grant/phase/outcome consistency. Native full history/header/freshness validation stays separately required; compatible reader permits additive observations.
interruption_development.repair: Derive dependencies_retained from the same actual worker observation used in the row. Retain old contradictory ledger from natural process-exit race; native tests assert every observation consistency.
interruption_development.remaining: Full exact-source normal composition qualification and owner work review.

normal_admission.capability: filesystem.tree.extract selected in native-bootstrap implemented_commands and generator allowlist; canonical global catalog remains proposed, not a stable public API qualification. Normal executable links real action/controller/worker; separate fault and disabled compositions retain explicit controls/refusal.
normal_admission.response_contract: Closed preparation/execution/unknown/inspection/watch variants with exact review SHA256, response/receipt/admission/process identities, grants/store facts, terminal worker/outcome, bounded retained history and cursor. Native independent resource/full-history semantics remain required. Schema validity grants no actor/physical/replay authority.
normal_admission.next_gate: Local clean work-unit qualification passed at087f95b4; owner acceptance, other-host/provider and full release gates remain.

current_worker_budget_extension.scope: Four inherited kernel slot leases with existing private worker/controller jobs; preserve every caller ancestry and four/128MiB/512MiB ceilings. Earlier source-bound shared-job qualification remains historical.
current_worker_budget_extension.private_handles: Two additional query-only slot and legacy guard capabilities are explicit in the compiled private role argv. Marker jobs remain unassociated; they are not described as enforcing memory.
current_worker_budget_extension.controller: Controllers retain two-process/256MiB private jobs; each child independently obtains another lease and retains inherited controller restrictions.
